author: codex-maclaptop
why: The Brain's open-work list said this family was red on the Mac: 'the route-walk family (Eastside times out, HomeDrive stalls at 0 legs, SpiritRoute wipes out on leg 1)'. Re-measured against the current build rather than trusted, because a stale red list is how a working course gets re-diagnosed from scratch.

results.windows_comparison: Windows round 4/5 reported 195.25 / 194.12 cm - the same course, the same result.
Windows reported completedLegs 2, travel 213816 cm, wipeouts 0 after their punk-freeze fix - which is now merged here as 3e1bc71 and is the likely reason this passes.

note_on_the_pavement_rule: BattleEastsideAudit requires 94% of ground samples to be on RidePath/RideDirt, not 99%: the threshold was set in round 3c after the route was measured at 95.2-95.3%, with the comment that 94% still catches real off-route detours. This run measured 94.38%, so the pass is a real pass against the real rule rather than a gate that let itself through.
not_claimed: These three are still outside the 29-audit sweep because they drive the whole course and take minutes each. Their passing here is a measurement, not a schedule.
